note: Literature indicates core LRRC7 features are intellectual disability, autism, ADHD, and hyperphagia, while microcephaly and specific tonic seizures are infrequent or variable.

evidence.text: Across a cohort of 33 individuals with LRRC7-related neurodevelopmental disorder, core findings were intellectual disability, autism, ADHD, aggression, and hyperphagia, whereas seizures were noted in only six individuals.

evidence.text: A proband harboring a novel de novo LRRC7 missense variant [c.2660C>T; p.(Pro887Leu)] presented with tonic seizures, failure to thrive, hypotonia, and mild microcephaly, expanding the phenotypic spectrum, while microcephaly is noted in roughly one-third of reported cases.
